title: 十年后的情书 · Bức thư tình mười năm sau
_note: Mỗi khung: n (số thứ tự → file s10-01_p<n>), paras (chỉ số đoạn văn khung này minh họa, đoạn thứ 2+ dùng lại ảnh với góc cắt khác), tag (nhãn tiếng Việt), prompt ({ten} = nhân vật, {@noi} = bối cảnh trong characters.json).

s10-01.prompt: {luming} stands in front of {@postoffice} on a bright festive morning, red lanterns hanging all along the old street, she holds up her camera excitedly

lines.zh: 老街那家老邮局，月底就要关门了，听说房子也要拆掉。今年是它最后一次送‘时光邮筒’里的信，你去写一篇文章。
时光邮筒是我们的老传统。大家把信交给我们，我们替他们保存，十年以后的七夕，再一封一封地送到收信人手里。

s10-01.prompt: In {@storeroom}, {gezi} proudly lifts a corner of the red velvet cloth to show {luming} hundreds of old envelopes inside the wooden box, dust floating in a beam of light

lines.zh: 一共三百一十二封，都是十年前写的。
仓库的钥匙只有两把，一把在我这儿，一把在阿栗那儿。对我来说，每一封信都是一个约定，不能早一天，也不能晚一天。

s10-01.prompt: {ali} bursts through the door into {@hall} with an overstuffed mailbag, chestnut shells dropping behind him on the floor, {gezi} behind the counter laughing

lines.zh: 爷爷，今天的信送完了！
说了多少次了，工作的时候别吃栗子。

s10-01.prompt: In {@hall}, {cici} shyly holds a bouquet of white lilies at the counter, while {ali} stands behind her blushing bright red and staring at her, frozen

lines.zh: 爷爷，七夕的信……什么时候送？
七夕那天上午，一封都不会少。
谢谢
那孩子天天来问同一个问题。他们俩是中学同学，一个在街这边，一个在街那边，见了面却连话都说不好。

s10-01.prompt: In {@office} at sunset, {yebai} lies on the windowsill with a pack of dried fish on his belly, pretending to sleep, while {luming} leans over him teasing with a sly grin

lines.zh: 快到七夕了，鹊桥灯会那天，你打算请谁去看灯呀？比如说……某位很厉害的女警察？
真睡着的猫，尾巴是不会动的。

s10-01.prompt: Early morning, {luming} sits up in bed in pajamas answering a ringing phone, eyes wide with shock, morning light through curtains, dramatic tension

lines.zh: 鹿鸣，你快来！仓库的门还锁得好好的，可是……可是那个装信的木盒子，不见了！三百一十二封信，全都不见了！

s10-02.prompt: A police car parked in front of {@postoffice}; {baishuang} stands at the storeroom door writing in a notebook and glances sideways, slightly flustered, as {yebai} and {luming} hurry in

lines.zh: 你来得太晚了。
小偷又不会回来第二次。

s10-02.tag: Cửa sổ quá nhỏ, quá cao
s10-02.prompt: Inside {@storeroom}, the table is empty, the heavy door lock is intact; {luming} looks up at the tiny barred vent window high on the wall, puzzled

lines.zh: 钥匙只有两把，
一把在局长身上，一把在阿栗那儿。两个人都说，钥匙昨晚一直没离开过自己。
这么小的窗户，连老鼠都很难钻进来，更别说搬走一个大盒子了。

s10-02.prompt: Close-up: {yebai} lifts the red velvet cloth toward the light, revealing many tiny pinholes in the fabric; scattered yellow pollen powder on the wooden floor below

s10-02.tag: Bưu kiện ghi sai địa chỉ
s10-02.prompt: In {@hall}, {gezi} wipes his glasses and sighs while talking to {baishuang} who takes notes; behind the counter sits a pile of parcels

lines.zh: 昨天邮局有没有什么特别的事？
昨天忙得不得了！七夕快到了，寄东西的人特别多。下午还来了一个很大的包裹，地址写错了，根本没有那个地方，只好先放进仓库里过夜。今天一大早，我就按老规定，把它退回给寄件人了。唉，八十年了，这种事从来没发生过……

s10-02.prompt: {baishuang} whispers to {yebai} with her ears twitching, annoyed but slightly blushing, {yebai} with paws behind his back smirking; in the doorway {ali} stands pale, clutching a key

lines.zh: 你看出什么了？
看出你昨天晚上又没睡好。
我问的是案子！
哦，案子啊，
案子还没把答案告诉我。
别怕，孩子，我相信你。
谢谢爷爷

s10-02.prompt: {baishuang} crouches and shines a flashlight under an old bookshelf in {@storeroom}, revealing a small pile of dusty chestnut shells; {gezi} and {luming} turn to look at {ali} in shock

lines.zh: 这是什么？

s10-03.prompt: {ali} waves his paws nervously, face red, in front of a stern {baishuang} who questions him with arms crossed; {gezi} looks worried in {@hall}

lines.zh: 不、不是我！
我没有拿那些信！
你有钥匙，这里又有你的栗子壳。你最好说清楚，这些壳是什么时候留下的？
上个星期……有一天晚上，我一个人进来过。
那么晚，你进仓库干什么？
我……我不能说。可是我什么都没拿，真的！我在这里坐了很久，后来就回家了。

s10-03.prompt: {yebai} crouches by the bookshelf and examines the dusty chestnut shells with one claw, thoughtful, while {baishuang} frowns behind him

lines.zh: 这些壳上落满了灰，颜色也变暗了，
至少放了好几天，不是昨天晚上留下的。
你是说，他说的是真话？
我只是说，壳不会说谎。至于人会不会，那是另一回事。
你就不能说得简单一点儿吗？
说得简单，你就不会来找我了。
我得去查一查那家建筑公司。他们一直希望邮局早点儿关门，派来的经理姓石，是一头犀牛。

s10-03.tag: Ánh mắt hướng về tiệm hoa
s10-03.prompt: {ali} stands alone outside {@postoffice}, gazing longingly across the street at {@flowershop}; {luming} notices from the doorway
{luming} and {yebai} walk home along the old street in the evening glow, {luming} talking eagerly, {yebai} yawning with paws in his coat pockets

lines.zh: 你觉得阿栗那天晚上到底在仓库里做什么？一个人半夜坐在三百多封信旁边，不拿东西，也不说原因。
每个人都有秘密。有的秘密跟案子有关，有的只跟心有关。
那他的秘密是哪一种？

s10-03.tag: Bóng khổng lồ lúc nửa đêm
s10-03.prompt: Night, moonlight over {@postoffice}; {luming} hides behind a tree, heart pounding, watching a giant shadowy silhouette measure the post office wall with a long tape measure, mysterious atmosphere

s10-04.prompt: {shi} squeezes into the small {@hall}, making it look tiny, and unrolls a blueprint of a tall skyscraper across the counter; {baishuang} questions him

lines.zh: 我很忙，有话快说。
这是我的工作。这座房子太旧了，早一天拆，就能早一天开工。说实话，我确实希望邮局早点儿关门，可那又怎么样？

s10-04.prompt: {yebai} calmly points at the tiny storeroom door, while {shi}, far too big to fit through it, looks at the door in surprise; {luming} holds back a laugh

lines.zh: 石经理，你能进这个门吗？

s10-04.prompt: {shi} stops in the doorway of the post office with his back turned, head lowered, the rolled blueprint hanging from his hand, a lonely melancholy mood

lines.zh: 我又不是坏人。我妈……我妈也有一封信在那个盒子里。

s10-04.prompt: Inside {@flowershop}, {cici} wraps a bouquet of lilies, yellow pollen on her apron, her hands trembling nervously, while {luming} chats cheerfully

lines.zh: 你、你要什么花？
盒子不见了，三百多封信，一封都找不到，灰鸽爷爷急得两天没好好吃饭。
那……七夕的信，还能送吗？
放心吧，夜白一定能找回来的。

s10-04.prompt: In {@noodleshop} at night, {baishuang} sits awkwardly across from {yebai} with two bowls of noodles and one fried fish between them, both reaching for the fish and bickering; {xiongshen} peeks from the kitchen smiling

lines.zh: 我……正好饿了，一起吃碗面吧。
哎呀，真难得！

s10-04.prompt: Dawn, blue light, {gezi} opens the round green mailbox in front of {@postoffice} and finds a stack of old envelopes inside, astonished

lines.zh: 鹿鸣，信……信回来了！邮局门口的邮筒里，多了二十封时光邮筒的信！

s10-05.prompt: In {@hall}, {gezi} carefully wipes twenty old envelopes one by one on the counter, as {luming} and {yebai} rush in

lines.zh: 一封都没有破，邮票也都在。
偷信的人，为什么又把信还回来了？

s10-05.prompt: {luming} holds an old envelope up against the window light, showing many tiny pinholes; {yebai} sniffs it curiously

lines.zh: 夜白，你闻闻，这些信是不是有一股香味？
是花香。味道太重了，我的鼻子受不了。
带一封回去，再把那天在库房地上收起来的黄色粉末也带上。

s10-05.prompt: In {@noodleshop} at noon, {xiongshen} sniffs an envelope and smiles knowingly, {doudou} beside her points at yellow pollen, {luming} takes notes

lines.zh: 这不是百合花的味道吗？我年轻时最喜欢百合了。
这个我也认识！我妈妈养过百合，花中间那几根长长的东西，一碰就是满手这种黄粉，怎么洗都洗不掉。

s10-05.prompt: {yebai} sunbathes on the windowsill of {@office}, eyes half closed as if sleeping, but his tail flicks rhythmically while he thinks

lines.zh: 你们不觉得奇怪吗？如果是为了钱，时光信根本不值钱；如果是为了破坏，他应该把信扔掉或者烧掉。可是他偷走了，又每天还回来一些，一封都没有弄坏。
难道他是在……找东西？
对。
他要的不是三百多封信，而是其中的一封。每天晚上看一些，没找到的，就还回来。

s10-05.prompt: At a noodle shop table, {baishuang} looks down shyly poking her noodles with chopsticks as she asks a question; {yebai} stares out the window, tail frozen; {luming} peeks through a crack in the kitchen door

lines.zh: 七夕那天……你有空吗？
要看案子。
也对，案子要紧。我回局里了。
你这只笨猫！她是在约你啊！

s10-05.prompt: Evening in {@hall}, returned envelopes stacked neatly on the table, {ali} counting them one by one, {gezi}, {yebai} and {luming} watching, tense

lines.zh: 三百一十一封。
一共是三百一十二封。还有一封，没有回来。

s10-06.prompt: Early morning, {yebai} reads a thick, worn logbook on the post office counter, flipping pages with a claw; {gezi} watches; {luming} waits impatiently

lines.zh: 你到底在找什么？丢的是信，又不是包裹。
眼睛会骗人，细节不会。小偷能进锁着的房间，一定用了一个大家都没注意的办法。
灰鸽爷爷，那天您说过，有一个大包裹写错了地址，对吗？

s10-06.prompt: {gezi} spreads his wings wide to show the size of a big cardboard parcel, explaining to {yebai} and {luming} in {@hall}

lines.zh: 对，是那天下午四点多送来的，大概有这么大。
地址写的是鹊桥路九十九号，可是鹊桥路一共只有八十号。按照规定，送不出去的包裹先放在库房里过夜，第二天早上退回寄件人。
奇怪的是，那个箱子看起来很大，拿起来却挺轻的。

s10-06.prompt: {ali} with his mailbag joins the conversation, miming carrying a very heavy box with strained arms

lines.zh: 那个箱子是我第二天一早送回去的。我记得特别清楚，因为它比前一天重多了，我差点儿闪了腰。花店还没开门，我就把它放在后院门口了。
前一天很轻，第二天很重。一个关在库房里的箱子，怎么会自己变重？

s10-06.prompt: Close-up of {luming} reading the logbook, her face frozen in shock; in the background {ali} turns red and then pale

lines.zh: 下午四点二十分，大包裹一件，寄件人——
七夕的信什么时候送？
不可能吧？
刺刺那么胆小，连说话都不敢大声。
刺刺……刺刺不会做这种事的！她只是把地址写错了而已！

s10-06.prompt: {yebai} carefully pulls one yellowed envelope out of a tall stack of letters and hands it to {gezi}, serious expression

lines.zh: 这一封，先请你替我保管吧。
以后你就会知道了。

s10-06.prompt: {@flowershop} is closed: glass door shut, no flowers displayed outside, a small blank wooden sign hanging on the door; {yebai}, {luming} and {ali} stand outside looking worried

s10-07.prompt: {yang} leans out of his steaming bun shop next to {@flowershop}, telling {luming} and {yebai} something in a hushed voice

lines.zh: 找刺刺啊？她这几天怪得很。我每天半夜起来做包子，总看见她一个人抱着东西出门，一两点才回来。

s10-07.prompt: In the backyard of the flower shop, {baishuang} in gloves opens a large cardboard box covered with tiny holes, yellow pollen inside and a red velvet thread; {luming} sniffs it; {yebai} watches
{yebai} stands on top of a flower pot like a stage, explaining the case with a raised claw, while {luming} and {baishuang} listen intently among the flowers

lines.zh: 好了，现在可以把整个故事讲一遍了。
先说库房。门锁没有坏，钥匙只有灰鸽爷爷和阿栗有；唯一的窗户又小又高，连我都钻不进去。所以，小偷不是自己闯进去的，而是被邮局的人亲手‘请’进去的。
请进去？
对，被当成一个包裹，搬进去的。

s10-07.prompt: Flashback scene in soft sepia tones: {cici} curled into a spiky ball inside a cardboard box in a dark storeroom, hugging a wooden box of letters, a sliver of moonlight

lines.zh: 那天下午，刺刺在自己的花店寄了一个大包裹，故意写了一个不存在的地址。然后，她躲进了箱子里。刺猬害怕的时候会缩成一个球，变得很小，所以一个纸箱就够了。按照规定，送不出去的包裹要在库房里放一夜。等到半夜，邮局里没有人了，她就从箱子里爬出来。
可是库房里没有灯，她看不清信封上的名字，找不到自己想要的那一封。
没办法，她只好把整个信箱抱进纸箱，和自己一起藏好。她身上的刺扎在红丝绒布上，留下了那些小洞；她每天跟百合花在一起，身上的花粉掉在了地上。第二天早上，阿栗按照规定把包裹退回寄件人，也就是说，亲手把她和三百多封信一起送回了花店。所以，箱子才突然变重了。

s10-07.tag: Tối nay cô ấy sẽ đến
s10-07.prompt: Sunset, {yebai}, {baishuang} and {luming} stand side by side looking across the street at the round green mailbox in front of {@postoffice}, long shadows

lines.zh: 锁没坏，窗户进不去，地上有花粉，布上有小洞，包裹先轻后重……全都对上了。
可是，她为什么要这么做？她每天晚上偷偷把信还回来，说明她不是坏人。那最后一封信到底写了什么，让她这么害怕？
她还剩最后一封没有还。今天晚上，她会再来的。
那我们就在这儿等她。

s10-08.prompt: Late night, an empty old street under yellow streetlights; {luming} crouches behind a wall with tired legs while {baishuang} waits perfectly still beside her, watching the green mailbox
A small round shadowy figure stands at the green mailbox under a streetlight, holding an envelope near the slot, hesitating, pulling it back again

lines.zh: 别动，警察！

s10-08.prompt: A flashlight beam; {cici} has curled into a frightened spiky ball on the ground; {luming} kneels down gently beside her

lines.zh: 啊！
刺刺，别怕，是我，鹿鸣。

s10-08.prompt: {cici} sits on the stone step beside the green mailbox, crying and holding an old envelope to her chest, under a warm streetlight at night

lines.zh: 对不起……信是我拿的。十年前，我十二岁，给一个人写了一封信，告诉他……我喜欢他。那时候，我觉得十年好长好长，长到什么都会变。可是十年过去了，我们成了最好的朋友，每天都见面。他来我店里喝茶，我去邮局给他送花。我怕……我怕他收到这封信以后，我们连朋友都做不成了。
那天晚上，库房里太黑，我什么都看不清，只好把整个箱子都抱走了。
回家以后，我每天晚上找一些，没找到的就送回来。别人的信，我连名字都不敢看，那是别人的秘密，我只认自己的字。前几天，我终于找到了我的信。我本来想把它撕掉的，可是拿在手里，怎么也撕不下去。那是十二岁的我，鼓了好大的勇气才写下的啊。

s10-08.prompt: {luming} wipes tears from her eyes while {baishuang} sits down beside {cici} and puts a gentle paw on her shoulder, night street

lines.zh: 所以，你今天晚上来，是想把它也还回去？
我想还……可是我不敢。我宁可他永远不知道。

s10-08.prompt: {yebai} hands a yellowed old envelope with a child's handwriting to {cici} under the streetlight; she looks at it in disbelief

lines.zh: 刺刺，这封信，你看过收信人的名字吗？

s10-09.prompt: {cici} reads an old envelope in the beam of a flashlight held by {baishuang}; {yebai} sits beside the mailbox with his tail curled around his feet

lines.zh: 栗阳……是阿栗的名字。
这……这怎么可能？
这封信是前天晚上跟别的信一起回来的。灰鸽爷爷认出了名字，把它交给我保管。你那天在黑暗里只顾着找自己的信，所以没有注意到它。
还记得仓库架子下面那些栗子壳吗？大家都以为是偷信的人留下的。可是我第一天就发现，壳上有一层薄薄的灰，比盒子丢的时间早好几天。

s10-09.prompt: Flashback scene in soft sepia tones: {ali} sits alone at night in {@storeroom} beside the velvet-covered box, nervously eating chestnuts, shells piling at his feet, lost in thought

lines.zh: 对了！阿栗说过，上个星期他一个人晚上进过仓库，可是他怎么也不肯说去干什么！
他是去拿自己的信的，对不对？他也害怕这封信在七夕那天送出去！
一个人半夜坐在放信的屋子里，一边紧张地吃栗子，一边看着那个盒子，一坐就是很久。他本来想拿回自己的信，可是最后，他什么也没拿。因为这封信一直好好地躺在盒子里，直到你把整个盒子抱走。
我猜，他是决定把这件事交给十年前的自己。

s10-09.prompt: Morning in {@hall}, {cici} bows deeply before {gezi}, a big cardboard box and one letter on the counter; {gezi} smiles gently and kindly

lines.zh: 孩子，三百一十一封信，你一封一封地送回来，一封也没有少，也没有弄坏。我送了五十年信，知道一个人为了一封信能有多紧张。爷爷不怪你。

s10-09.tag: Mỗi lá thư là một lời hẹn
s10-09.prompt: {luming} holds {cici}'s paw warmly; {baishuang} closes her notebook with a soft expression; morning light in the post office

lines.zh: 爷爷常说，每一封信都是一个约定。写信的人相信，十年以后它一定会准时到达。刺刺，你的信也一样。十二岁的你那么勇敢地把它写下来，也一直在等这一天呀。你真的要替她取消这个约定吗？
所有的信都回来了，邮局也不打算追究，这个案子……就当作一场误会吧。阿栗那边，我们谁也不说，七夕那天让信自己去找收信人。
不过，下次不许再把自己装进箱子寄出去了，明白吗？

s10-09.prompt: Bright morning street, {yebai} walks ahead yawning and stretching, {luming} walks behind watching his back with a sly matchmaker smile

lines.zh: 喂，侦探先生，十年前的信都有人勇敢地写了。那你呢？你也该写一封信了吧。

s10-10.prompt: Qixi morning, a long queue of animals of all ages, elderly and families, in front of {@postoffice} decorated with red ribbons
Inside the crowded post office, {luming} with her camera in a corner, {yebai} leaning by the window, {baishuang} with her silver crescent-moon hair clip glancing at him

lines.zh: 我的爪子是用来抓小鱼干的，不是用来写信的。

s10-10.prompt: {shi} stands by the post office window holding an old letter, his eyes red and teary, the huge rhino deeply moved, soft light

lines.zh: 我妈妈在信里说，我小时候最喜欢趴在这个窗台上，看邮递员把信送到很远很远的地方。她说，希望我长大以后，也能做一个让别人等得到消息的人。
这座楼，我们不拆了！

s10-10.prompt: {baishuang} reads an old letter written in a child's handwriting, then looks up toward {yebai} by the window, emotional

lines.zh: 白霜。
十二岁的我问，十年以后，有没有一个相信我的朋友。喂，侦探，你说我该怎么回答她？

s10-10.tag: Cô nói gì tôi cũng tin
s10-10.prompt: {yebai} turns his face away toward the window, tail swishing, cheeks faintly flushed, while {baishuang} smiles softly behind him

lines.zh: 你抓人，我找线索，你说什么我都信——这种问题，还用问吗？

s10-10.prompt: {gezi} hands letters to {ali} and {cici} at the same moment; they look up at each other in the middle of the crowd, surprised and blushing

lines.zh: 这两封信是同一天寄的，那就一起送吧。栗阳，刺刺。

s10-11.prompt: Wide shot of {@bridge}; {ali} and {cici} walk slowly side by side among the crowd, magical romantic atmosphere

s10-11.tag: Thư của cậu, tớ đọc rồi
s10-11.prompt: In the middle of the lantern bridge, {ali} blushes, gripping a letter, two chestnuts rolling from his pocket to {cici}'s feet; her spines stand up shyly but she does not turn away

lines.zh: 你的信……我看了。
你说，我每天都把最大的栗子分给你。其实……那不是因为栗子太多吃不完。是因为，最大的那个，我只想给你。
你的信我也看了。
你说，我的刺一点儿也不可怕；你还说，长大以后你要当邮递员，每天第一个给我送信。
所以……你真的当了邮递员。而我开花店的时候，特意选了邮局对面。

s10-11.prompt: Close-up on the lantern bridge: {ali} places a big shiny chestnut into {cici}'s open palm, both blushing, warm lantern glow, sweet and innocent

lines.zh: 上个星期那天晚上，我一个人在仓库里坐到快天亮，吃了半口袋栗子。我想把信拿回来，因为我害怕，害怕你只把我当好朋友。可是我又想：要是你也一样呢？要是我拿走了，我们就永远不知道了。所以我把信留下了，让十年后的我们自己决定。
刺刺，十年前我写的话，现在还算数。不对，比十年前还多。

s10-11.prompt: Riverside path under willow trees at night with distant lanterns, {baishuang} walks ahead, {yebai} follows behind with his paws in his coat pockets

lines.zh: 那个发夹……第一天在邮局，我就看见了。银色的月亮，很适合你。

s10-11.prompt: Under the willows, {yebai} awkwardly holds out a new red envelope to {baishuang}, looking away shyly; she looks surprised

lines.zh: 灰鸽爷爷说，新的时光邮筒下个月开放，这是第一个信封。我写了，可是现在不许拆。
十年以后才能拆。这是规定。

s10-11.prompt: {baishuang} smiles beautifully holding the red envelope to her chest beside {yebai} under the glowing lanterns; far in the foreground, {luming} quietly takes their photo

lines.zh: 那说好了。
十年以后，你陪我一起拆。
嗯

s10-12.prompt: The renovated {@postoffice} with a fresh new signboard, {shi} wearing a yellow hard hat helps workers repair the roof, sunny day

lines.zh: 时光邮局

s10-12.prompt: Interior of the new post office, half post office counter and half flower shop full of lilies; {ali} and {cici} work happily side by side
{gezi} sits on an old chair by the sunny window drinking tea, telling stories to a group of little animal children

lines.zh: 写信的时候，别想着要写得多好看。把心里的话写下来，时间会替你保管。

s10-12.prompt: {xiongshen}, {doudou}, {achen} and {luming} write letters together at a table beside a new red time-capsule mailbox, joyful

lines.zh: 十年后还在写新闻的我
我的信已经交给收信人了。

s10-12.prompt: {luming} proudly holds up a newspaper in front of the post office, smiling, morning sun
In {@office}, {yebai} lies on the windowsill pretending to sleep while {baishuang} gently places a lunch box beside him; his tail wags slightly; {luming} smiles and writes in her notebook

lines.zh: 鱼是我自己做的。好吃不好吃都得吃完，不许剩下。
这个城市里最难破的案子，不是谁偷了什么，而是谁先说出那句‘我喜欢你’。不过没关系，我们还有十年，慢慢来。
